_doc: Which standard launch knobs each live compose must read, and the declared exceptions. Checked by scripts/lib/profiles/knob_conformance.py (run by test-launch-knobs); its docstring has the rules. not_wired.reads_instead is a related setting found by name, not proof it means the same: check what it does before mapping the knob onto it.

REASONING_EFFORT.why: a server-side default effort, for models whose template takes reasoning_effort

ENABLE_THINKING.why: a server-side thinking on / off, for models whose template takes enable_thinking

THINKING_BUDGETS.why: per-effort thinking budgets (effort_budget.py), for models with Qwen3.8's effort levels

SPEC_N.why: the draft depth, for every slug with a drafter or a spec method

KV_OFFLOAD_GB.why: an opt-in feature of the KV-offload composes, not expected of every compose

KV_OFFLOAD_DISK.why: an opt-in feature of the KV-offload composes

ROPE_SCALING.why: an opt-in long-context extension (past a model's trained length); a slug at or under its trained context needs no scaling, and setup resolves yarn itself past it

ROPE_SCALE.why: the factor of an opt-in long-context extension; under linear/yarn with it unset the factor derives from CONTEXT, exactly as setup's own resolution

KV_OFFLOAD_DISK_GB.why: an opt-in feature of the KV-offload composes

unsupported.why: QEngine (from 1.3.4) has one default thinking budget (QE_THINKING_BUDGET) plus a per-request one, not a budget per effort level, so the effort map isn't wired; the slugs forward QE_THINKING_BUDGET as-is
